name: Morgan Ventures Limited
about: Morgan Ventures Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company manages public issues; and offers various services, including managing public issues, corporate advisory, corporate restructuring, capital market advisory, takeovers, mergers and acquisitions, etc. It also engages in trading of capital equipment; fee-based activities; and fund based activities, as well as invests in securities. The company was formerly known as Doogar Associates Limited and changed its name to Morgan Ventures Limited in 2004. Morgan Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India.
